summary: This video highlights a Dragonheir fansite built by community member Fenume that tracks banner history and schedules. The creator showcases how S9 players can use the Banner History & Generator tool to plan their summon resources. Upcoming S9 banners shown include Anneliesis, Selected Summons featuring Holfast, Option Summons, and the New Leaf Summon for Yfeir. The tool also includes hero tier lists, gear databases, and challenge trackers.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
